Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content Manager role at Jobgether's partner company. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I've spent the past years building and optimizing websites, writing English-language content, and using AI tools daily to streamline production.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I create SEO blog posts, manage CMS content in WordPress, and use Claude and ChatGPT for research, drafting, and audits. I've also developed AI-assisted workflows, including prompt engineering and MCP integrations, to speed up content creation. My experience testing user journeys and ensuring accurate content implementation aligns well with your focus on quality assurance and seamless experiences.

I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to a digital well-being platform and to experiment with new content formats like quizzes and interactive exercises. I'm confident my writing skills, attention to detail, and curiosity for AI-powered solutions would make me a strong fit.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Content Manager position at Jobgether's partner company. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to a platform that positively impacts users' well-being worldwide.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO specialist and junior digital marketer, I have developed and managed engaging English-language content for various websites. I regularly use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate content production, from drafting blog posts to conducting research and audits. For example, I have created prompt templates and workflows that streamline video script generation and content ideation, ensuring consistency and efficiency. My hands-on experience with content management systems, particularly WordPress, has honed my ability to upload, configure, and test content accurately before release.

One project that demonstrates my attention to detail and creativity is the development of mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and ran iterative technical SEO audits to improve search health. I also built a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages on a pharmacists' association site, ensuring a seamless user experience. These experiences have taught me the importance of testing user journeys and identifying potential issues early.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines creativity, technology, and purpose. I am excited about the opportunity to develop new in-app content formats, such as quizzes and practical exercises, and to leverage AI tools to explore innovative solutions. My genuine interest in mental health and personal development aligns with the platform's mission, and I am confident that my writing skills, organizational abilities, and curiosity would allow me to contribute meaningfully.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
